bound_definition: Observed lower growth = minimum post PSS minus maximum baseline PSS; observed upper growth = maximum post PSS minus minimum baseline PSS. Raw signed growth is never clamped. Only the ratio denominator has a 1 MiB floor.
scope: Whole-process kernel PSS growth after successful native GC requests and fixed ten-second waits. No claim of confirmed GC completion, exact live malloc bytes, open descriptors, or three-fold absolute process PSS.
business_change: Both variants expose the same ordinary seven-day hourly forecast details for ten supported cities. Every hourly field is displayed by the detail page; no padding fields. Actual server retrieval time is displayed, and weather values are deterministic synthetic fixtures. The sole variant difference remains retained HTTP requests and complete response strings versus release.
reason: Prospective forty-refresh sustained-use protocol, independent of the ongoing twenty-refresh diagnostic. Start formal collection only after both hourly functionality and the diagnostic screen are verified. Preserve all earlier failures.
